releases.notes: New corner paper check on the Tram tab: paper test at the centre and each knob, gives knob turns and checks the mesh at each corner.

New Bed shape analysis finds bulges, dips and twist, with fixes that need no new plate: tape map, hot leveling, and fitting the mesh to a fine scan. Animated turn coach shows exactly how far to turn each knob; tramming now removes twist too. Set your own nozzle and bed temperatures for SD prints, get alerts when a heater drifts, and smart passes re-probe when readings disagree.

history.notes: New corner paper check on the Tram tab: paper test at the centre and each knob, gives knob turns and checks the mesh at each corner.

New Bed shape analysis finds bulges, dips and twist, with fixes that need no new plate: tape map, hot leveling, and fitting the mesh to a fine scan. Animated turn coach shows exactly how far to turn each knob; tramming now removes twist too. Set your own nozzle and bed temperatures for SD prints, get alerts when a heater drifts, and smart passes re-probe when readings disagree.

Fixed Fine scan stopping with "The probe did not report a height". It now scans only where the printer's probe can reach (the same area Auto level uses), and a point the printer refuses is measured as close to it as possible instead of failing the whole scan.

Home now tells you exactly what to do when the bed isn't ready, step by step. A bent bed now offers Fine scan first instead of leveling again. New 'What the words mean' card explains mesh, tram, warp and the other terms.

Clearer ready-to-print status: the main score now shows how level prints will be with the mesh on, so a warped bed the mesh corrects no longer shows red. Tramming goes green when every knob says Leave it. New 'In the printer now' card shows mesh on, saved and Z offset.

Check a sliced G-code file before printing: it catches the settings that make small parts come loose (mesh off, first layer too fast or with the fan on, no brim, too hot, no Z hop). New small-part test print, filament profiles from your spool label (Hyper PLA added), and a first-layer alert during prints. The Wi-Fi status page now uses the right Wi-Fi address, stays on with the screen off, and has a Test button with fixes.
Settings now has a Check for updates now button that shows right away whether a newer version is available.

New Home checklist takes you step by step to a ready-to-print bed, showing what is green, amber and red. Clearer knob dials show exactly how far and which way to turn. New Print tab watches SD prints (time left, finish time, pause/stop) and can be shared with another phone over Wi-Fi or ntfy alerts, plus a quick first-layer test print.

Fixed the bed tramming error ("out of the probe's reach"). New Quick check: measure the four knobs cold in seconds, with how much each knob moved since the last check. The probing animation now follows where the probe really is.
New app icon: minimalist 3D printer printing a panda — dark navy background with glowing amber nozzle.
First release — automatic bed levelling for Bambu Lab Panda printers over USB. Connect, probe, and get a live mesh with one tap.

releases.notes: Behind-the-scenes improvements to catalog loading and downloads.
Much faster, steadier downloads for large apps: the store now fetches in parallel pieces, drops slow connections and retries, and survives expired download links. Interrupted downloads resume.

Fixed price display on out-of-stock watches by ignoring EMI fees and preserving last recorded in-stock or Bhawar authorized reference prices. Added in-app startup update checks from Panda App Store.

Added Stock History & Hot Sellers tracking: view a live chronological feed of watches restocked and sold out on each price refresh, see stock velocity metrics (duration in stock), discover hot sellers, and jump straight to watch details to buy when in stock.

Smarter model-number matching across stores, so short models like F-91W and GA-2100 are found more reliably. 'Limited stock' now counts as available for Buy and cheapest-price. Clearer alerts when a watch hits your target price, plus visual polish.

releases.notes: New Slow motion: in a video's More menu, pick Slow or Very slow. Videos filmed in Slow-mo or at 60 fps slow down perfectly smoothly; normal videos get soft in-between frames so they glide instead of stepping.

New Filters: give any photo or video a richer look with Vivid, or let Auto fix brightness, contrast and colour in one tap. Use them on one clip or every clip. A video's Volume is now in its More menu.

history.notes: New Slow motion: in a video's More menu, pick Slow or Very slow. Videos filmed in Slow-mo or at 60 fps slow down perfectly smoothly; normal videos get soft in-between frames so they glide instead of stepping.

New Filters: give any photo or video a richer look with Vivid, or let Auto fix brightness, contrast and colour in one tap. Use them on one clip or every clip. A video's Volume is now in its More menu.
Brand new app icon featuring a 3D panda editing videos on a curved holographic timeline with clean round icon styling.
Fixes the crash when opening a video or adding photos and videos (on Samsung, Vivo and other phones). Scrubbing the timeline is safe again.

Refined timeline UI with high-contrast transition buttons, frosted glass lane controls, and clean monospace timecode; relocated auto-preview toggle to the preview window for an uncluttered layout; optimized playback to 60 FPS and coalesced seeking for buttery-smooth timeline scrubbing.

Fixed playback pausing after 2–3 seconds on the timeline; fixed audio desynchronization and decoder stalls on video transitions and volume adjustments; improved playback stability across all video qualities.
Redesigned song trimming screen with smooth marker dragging, clean Cyber Glass handles, tenths-of-a-second clock readouts, and high-precision nudge controls.
Full song waveform navigation with smooth front/left marker repositioning; in-screen autoplay preview toggle in audio trimmer and timeline.
Audio preview with seek playhead in YouTube song search; direct transition to song start marker trim screen upon selection.

New: Turn and fit. Turn a video filmed sideways so it stands upright and fills the screen, choose Fill the screen or Show whole picture, or flip it like a mirror. Find it under More on any photo or video.

Songs and videos in My songs and My videos now play inside the app. Changing the volume plays the sound straight away, smoothly and without flicker, with a Play button in the volume sheet. Stopping a save no longer blocks the next one, and Done after saving goes back to your videos.

Make videos with a song: pick photos and videos, add music, trim and move clips, add transitions and a fade to black or white at the start or end, and see the WhatsApp or Instagram length limit on the timeline. Save for WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook or YouTube.
